title: Bad states
hint: Define markings that must never be reached. A bad state is any marking where the condition holds, for example 2·P1 + P3 ≥ 3. P-invariants are tried first; otherwise the exact reachability graph is used.
invalid: Every term needs a non-zero integer coefficient and the constant must be an integer.
status.safeExact: Safe, no reachable marking satisfies it
status.violated: Violated, a reachable marking satisfies it
